cases.question: Two independent samples have means 10 and 8, sample variances 4 and 9, and sizes 16 and 36. Compute the Welch test statistic; no decision is requested.
cases.reference_solution:
Add the two estimated variances of the sample means.

$$SE=\sqrt{\frac{4}{16}+\frac{9}{36}}=\sqrt{\frac{1}{2}}$$

$$t=\frac{10-8}{\sqrt{1/2}}=2\sqrt{2}$$

cases.question: For weighted observations (x,y,w)=(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,2,1), form and solve the normal equations for y=a+bx.
cases.reference_solution:
The weighted sums are 4, 4, 6, 7 and 8.

$$\begin{pmatrix}4&4\\4&6\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}a\\b\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}7\\8\end{pmatrix}$$

$$b=\frac{1}{2},\quad a=\frac{5}{4}$$

cases.question: For series RLC with L=0.05 H and C=20 microfarad, find resonant angular frequency and impedance when R=8 ohm.
cases.reference_solution:
At resonance the inductive and capacitive reactances cancel.

$$\omega_0=\frac{1}{\sqrt{LC}}=1000\ \mathrm{rad/s}$$

$$Z(\omega_0)=8\ \mathrm{ohm}$$

cases.question: Light passes from refractive index 1.5 to 1.0. Derive the critical-angle equation and give an approximate angle.
cases.reference_solution:
At the critical angle the refracted angle is ninety degrees.

$$1.5\sin\theta_c=1$$

$$\sin\theta_c=\frac{2}{3}$$

The critical angle is approximately 41.81 degrees.

cases.question: Solve (x-1)/3+(x+2)/4=5/6 using separate derivation lines.
cases.reference_solution:
Multiply both sides by twelve.

$$4(x-1)+3(x+2)=10$$

$$7x+2=10$$

$$x=\frac{8}{7}$$

Substitution gives five sixths.

cases.question: For A=diag(4,9), write its positive definite square root and verify the product.
cases.reference_solution:
Take the positive square root of each diagonal entry.

$$B=\begin{pmatrix}2&0\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$$

$$B^2=\begin{pmatrix}4&0\\0&9\end{pmatrix}=A$$
